title: News Words: Embers
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/7979232.html

sentences.text: Welcome to the Voice of America's Newswords.
In January, sudden wildfires caused massive destruction in and around Los Angeles, California.
The palisades and eaten wildfires caused 29 deaths and the destruction of
more than 16 ,000 structures including homes, schools and shops.
The causes of the fires are under investigation, but officials say it is possible that strong
winds fueled embers from an earlier fire.
Embers are small pieces of burning coal or wood from a fire.
In some cases, embers are as hot as the fire that created them.
